name: GitHub Copilot
summary: GitHub Copilot works every step of the way, from an open issue to reviewing and merging a pull request. Use it in your editor, the terminal, on your desktop, and on GitHub.
description:
GitHub Copilot works every step of the way, from an open issue to reviewing and merging a pull request. Use it in your editor, the terminal, on your desktop, and on GitHub.

AI Code Completions: Suggest code snippets based on context. Natural Language Chat: Interact with codebase using conversational queries. Smart Actions: Enhance productivity with AI-driven suggestions. Pull Request Summaries: Generate summaries for code changes.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: GitHub's docs list Copilot Free with a limited allowance, including 2,000 completions a month. Paid plans are Pro at $10/month, Pro+ at $39/month and Max at $100/month, plus Business at $19 per user per month and Enterprise at $39 per user per month.

features: AI Code Completions: Suggest code snippets based on context.
Natural Language Chat: Interact with codebase using conversational queries.
Smart Actions: Enhance productivity with AI-driven suggestions.
Pull Request Summaries: Generate summaries for code changes.

howToUse.title: Enable Copilot in IDE
howToUse.description: Install GitHub Copilot extension in VS Code, JetBrains, or compatible editors.

howToUse.title: Write Code
howToUse.description: Start coding as usual—Copilot will suggest completions and snippets.

howToUse.title: Accept or Refine Suggestions
howToUse.description: Review and accept, reject, or edit Copilot suggestions in real time.

howToUse.title: Chat & Summarize
howToUse.description: Use chat or summary features for deeper code understanding.
